observations.action: EngineCommandlets.exe project.input ran Play/focus/600 frames/Pause/4 frames against the project.
observations.expected: Game play updates produce a bomb release and hit, then pause holds state.
observations.actual: Commandlet exit 0, result ok=true and frames=604, but no bomb release/hit appeared in the process log and authoring scene snapshots retained initial unit positions. This is not counted as gameplay evidence; further investigation needed before classifying the API behavior.

observations.action: Read Game.cpp, InstancedMeshComponent.cpp, InstancedMeshShadows.cpp, PointShadow.h and Common.hlsli at HEAD.
